title: Automatic Histograms: Leveraging Language Models for Text Dataset Exploration

bias_targets.methodology: Using interactive, LLM-generated histograms of semantically-clustered text attributes to visually identify uneven distributions, skews, and imbalances among subgroups in unstructured datasets.

Proposed as an intersectional use case for the tool, allowing users to categorize text features (e.g., verbs, word types) to visually surface and identify subtle gendered speaking patterns in conversational datasets.
